news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹9.81 loss per share (vs ₹15.41 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹9.81 loss per share (improved from ₹15.41 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹198.8m (down 19% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹63.8m (loss narrowed 36% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 58% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 39% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.8% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (8.8% average weekly change). Negative equity (-₹915m). Market cap is less than US$10m (₹432.9m market cap, or US$4.71m).

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹21.28 loss per share (vs ₹10.98 loss in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹21.28 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹10.98 loss in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹196.1m (down 31% from 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹138.3m (loss widened 94% from 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 45% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 38% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
